plugins.name: rr-policy-guards
plugins.description: Four PreToolUse guards enforcing Rational Reserve platform rules: rr-emoji-guard (pure-ASCII file writes), rr-bash-guard (no bare $VAR expansion), rr-brew-guard (supply-chain-risky brew flags/URL installs/untrusted taps), rr-tofu-guard (no direct tofu apply/destroy/import from a Bash tool use). Bypass env vars per-guard; every use audit-logged to ~/.rational-reserve/logs/.
